```{=html}
</svg><text x="366.454" y="334" font-size="23" fill="#1f2328" text-anchor="start" font-weight="400" textLength="756.1" lengthAdjust="spacing">— how many things it holds cleanly: demo 3 measures, p31 computes</text><text x="20" y="366" font-size="23" fill="#1f2328" text-anchor="start" font-weight="400">erase before writing = the delta rule (DeltaNet); old ink fading = decay (RetNet, Mamba-2, GLA)</text><text x="20" y="398" font-size="23" fill="#1f2328" text-anchor="start" font-weight="400">“usually the summary suffices; sometimes you need the transcript”: hybrids; no time stamp (W5 p60)</text><text x="20" y="440" font-size="23" fill="#dc2626" text-anchor="start" font-weight="700">where it fails</text><text x="20" y="472" font-size="23" fill="#1f2328" text-anchor="start" font-weight="400">it suggests a summary; the state is a sum of outer products, queried by dot product</text><text x="20" y="504" font-size="23" fill="#1f2328" text-anchor="start" font-weight="400">it does not say which layers of a hybrid should be attention: a hyperparameter with no principle yet</text><text x="20" y="536" font-size="23" fill="#1f2328" text-anchor="start" font-weight="400">it says nothing about MoE: a model can be both (Qwen3-Next, Kimi Linear, Kimi K3 are)</text></svg>
```
